newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel signs $90 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Piltel signs $90 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) said on Wednesday it had signed a syndicated loan worth $90 million with a group of foreign financial institutions.
Piltel said it had also signed a $20 million loan with Netherlands Development Finance Co.
The proceeds of the loans will be to partially fund the company's local exchange carrier project in southern Philippines, the telephone company said in a statement.
Piltel is installing over 400,000 telephone lines and related support systems in the southern part of Mindanao island.
The syndicated loan was underwritten by ABN AMRO Bank and ING Bank.
Piltel did not disclose the terms of the loans.
